title: Closed trades for one session
description: Every closed round trip for one trading day, uploaded once the session has ended. NOT a delta and NOT a live stream: the live state document (state.schema.json) carries only the most recent fills and no date at all, so a history built from it loses trades across every relay restart. This document is the whole day, is safe to send again, and replaces what the relay holds for that date.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Same major means compatible.

session_date.description: The exchange-local trading day these trades belong to.

complete.description: The sender asserts this is EVERY closed trade for session_date. The relay replaces the day on that basis, so a partial upload would delete real trades. Only true is accepted: a sender that cannot make the assertion must not use this endpoint.

source.description: Where the rows came from. Both read the same fill logs; this distinguishes a one-off reload from the nightly job.

trades.description: May be empty for a day with no closed trades. An empty array for a day the relay already holds trades for is refused, not obeyed.

trade_key.description: Stable identity, recomputed from the fill log rather than taken from it: the log's own id is a row index that restarts each day.

strategy.description: 'unattributed' where the fill log recorded none.

gross_pnl.description: Null where the fill log recorded no entry price. A total over a null must read unknown, never quietly short.

commission.description: Positive, as a cost. Derived as gross - net so the three figures always reconcile.

order_outcomes.description: Per-strategy counts of what happened to orders that day, filled and not. On 2026-09-16 the log held 950 rows of which 39 filled; a closed-trades-only history would have shown an unremarkable session.
